title: German-Style Oven Roasted Broad Beans
description: A twist on traditional Mexican broad beans with a German-inspired flavor from oregano and thyme. Simple to prepare, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse the broad beans and remove any stems or debris.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, oregano, thyme, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the broad beans to the bowl and toss to coat with the herb mixture.
Transfer the broad beans to a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
Check for doneness by inserting a fork – it should slide in easily.
Remove from the oven and serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
